algorithm: Compute the absolute values of the inputs.
Compute the greatest common divisor (GCD) of the absolute values using the Euclidean algorithm.
Use the formula: LCM(a, b) = (a * b) // GCD(a, b).
constraints: Inputs must be integers or 1-D lists of integers.
Supports scalar/scalar, scalar/list, list/scalar, and lists of the same length.
Values and results fit signed int64.
edge_cases: When both inputs are scalars, the output is an integer.
When one input is a list and the other is a scalar, the output is a list.
When inputs are empty lists, the output is an empty list.
When inputs are of different lengths, they are broadcasted to a common shape.
When inputs are not integers or lists, the function may raise an error.

parsed.output: A list or scalar, depending on input type. The output is the LCM of the absolute values of the inputs.
